description: 365Score Patches v1.4.1: Adds MX Player debloating, telemetry and ad SDK blocking, and a bypass for MX Player's native anti-tamper check that aborts patched builds.

patches.name: Block ad SDK loaders
patches.description: Prevents the Google Mobile Ads and Interactive Media Ads SDKs from loading any ad format in MX Player.

patches.name: Bypass DNS blocker check
patches.description: Disables private DNS / ad-blocker detection so video playback works seamlessly with AdGuard, NextDNS, and Pi-hole.

patches.name: Bypass integrity check
patches.description: Neutralises MX Player's native anti-tamper check (libmx-bh.so), which otherwise aborts the process with 'std::terminate' shortly after launch on any patched build.

patches.name: Debloat MX Player
patches.description: Hides the cleaner, file transfer, local network, local music and bottom promotion features from MX Player.

options.description: Hides the storage cleaner card in the media manager.
Hides the file transfer entry of the navigation drawer.
Hides the local network streaming entry of the navigation drawer.
Hides the local music entry of the navigation drawer.
Stops MX Player from showing bottom navigation promotion cards.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Removes banner, native, interstitial, exit, and app-open advertisements from MX Player.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Stops MX Player from reporting usage, screens, sessions and playback events to its own tracker, Firebase Analytics and AppsFlyer.

patches.name: Unlock Ad-Free mode
patches.description: Unlocks Ad-Free VIP status and enables skipping online video ads in MX Player.

patches.name: Block update screen
patches.description: Blocks the 'This app is out of date' update screen and popup on launch.

patches.name: Change version code
patches.description: Changes the version code of 365Score to prevent forced updates.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Removes banner and interstitial advertisements from 365Score.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Removes analytics and tracking (Firebase Analytics) from 365Score.

patches.name: MicroG integration
patches.description: Allows Google Sign-In and account sync to work on non-rooted devices by redirecting Google Play Services to ReVanced GmsCore / MicroG.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks 365Score premium/pro features (ad-free, tipster, plus, notification sounds).
